days.title: Botanical Splendor and Ancient Traces
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: conca di rododendri
stops.detail: The work of expanding the park was then carried forward by Felice Piacenza who dedicated over fifty years of his life to it, creating a spectacular rhododendron valley and implementing the creation of paths, roads and alleys in addition to the planting of further exotic species.

stops.name: insediamento protostorico
stops.detail: On the Bric Burcina the presence of a protohistoric settlement dating back to the Bronze and Iron Ages is also documented.
